Component: PBPE Agricultural Value Gateway / Agricultural Transformation Simulator
Purpose: Define one canonical gateway and simulator that translates verified agricultural transformation into value, impact attributes, and finance-ready outputs.
Core relation: Agricultural transaction → verified value attributes → PBPE Impact Layer → Verified Value → Finance
Governance constraint: No PBPE token/coin/currency/market/trading/supply/price model; impact records are not exchange media.

Status: MSC deployment, MBT55 application, waste/feedstock, soil baseline, climate conditions
Purpose: Upstream engines remain external truth providers where designated.

Status: Yield, quality, farm income, input/resource efficiency
Purpose: Must distinguish measured, modeled, and assumed values.

Status: Climate, soil/resource, biosecurity, food-loss, health and related verified value dimensions
Purpose: No aggregation into a currency unit.

Status: Cash flow, NPV, IRR, payback, capital requirement, risk-adjusted scenarios
Purpose: Financial instruments are downstream applications, not PBPE itself.

Status: Capital structure, carbon-price sensitivity, investment returns
Loss frequency/severity, risk reduction, premium impact
Purpose: Depends on biosecurity and yield-risk outputs.

Status: Production cost, supply stability, loss reduction, price volatility
Purpose: Must not equate agricultural products with carbon credits.
GHG is one value/impact dimension, not the sole valuation basis.
